description: Render diagram source (Mermaid, PlantUML, C4-PlantUML, Graphviz/DOT, D2, Structurizr, BPMN, Excalidraw) to an SVG or PNG image, and get a shareable link that opens the diagram in a browser. Use it when the user wants to see a diagram. If the source is invalid the result is an error with the parser message and line number: fix the source and retry. Call validate_diagram to check syntax without rendering, or list_formats for examples and which formats support PNG.

format.description: Diagram language. One of: mermaid, plantuml, c4plantuml, graphviz, d2, structurizr, bpmn, excalidraw, dot ("dot" is an alias for graphviz).

output.description: Image type. Defaults to svg. d2, bpmn and excalidraw support svg only.

source.description: The diagram source text, exactly as it would appear in a file of that format.

name: render_diagram
title: Render diagram
